title: 7 Moments a Godly Man Says No When Everything in Him Wants to Say Yes
caption:
Self-control isn't a personality trait. It's a hundred small moments where he says no to himself and nobody ever finds out.

7 of them: the extra hour of scrolling after lights-out, the fourth drink when three was the line, the 1 a.m. text, the shortcut nobody would catch, the scroll through her old posts, the joke at a brother's expense, the apology he could skip.

A guy who can govern himself can be trusted with everything else.

#faith #selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
